title: Two days in Hanoi
summary: Day one is Hoan Kiem Lake, the citadel, and the Temple of Literature. Day two is Ba Dinh and West Lake.

stops.name: Hoan Kiem Lake
stops.note: The lake path is free. The temple ticket is separate.

stops.name: Temple of Literature
stops.note: The daytime adult ticket is 70,000 VND.

stops.name: Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum
stops.note: Free on the operator FAQ, and 40,000 VND on Vietnam Tourism.

stops.name: West Lake
stops.note: The fee is Check on arrival.
